meta.note: Predictions only. Atlas rates are idle-machine medians; phase-1 bench files are the validation targets.

mlx_8bit_g64.desc: MLX affine int8, group 64, bf16 scale+bias

mlx_4bit_g64.desc: MLX affine int4, group 64, bf16 scale+bias (embedding quantized too)

q8_0.desc: GGUF Q8_0 (output/tied embd Q6_K by llama-quantize default)

q4_k_m.desc: GGUF Q4_K_M (Q4_K + Q6_K for 1/2 of attn_v, ffn_down, and output)

fp8_w8a16.desc: MAX float8_e4m3fn weight-only; lm_head kept bf16 (modelopt default)

nvfp4_w4a16.desc: MAX float4_e2m1fnx2 (NVFP4, fp8 scale per 16); lm_head kept bf16 (modelopt default)

int8_w8a8.desc: MAX Apple int8 W8A8 (per-channel weight scale, dynamic per-token act); lm_head bf16

fitted_params.how: decode: relative-error WLS of measured ms/token = ideal/eta_d + c_d over the 7 phase-1 rows; prefill: WLS of (TTFT - method extra decode steps) = ideal_pf/eta_p + c_http*[HTTP]

validation.method: llama-bench: TTFT=512/pp512 (one 512-token ubatch, logits for last token); tg128 on empty KV
HTTP client TTFT; 513 tokens (nonce) > n_ubatch 512 -> second 1-token ubatch = one extra full weight pass
HTTP client TTFT, single prefill pass (ReturnLogits.LAST_TOKEN)
max benchmark random dataset, mean input 534 tok, 6% prefix-cache hits
in-process; mlx_lm prefill of 511 tokens (no lm_head) + one M=1 step for the last prompt token
in-process; mlx_lm prefill of 511 tokens (no lm_head) + one M=1 step for the last prompt token

notes: multimodal checkpoint: vision tower excluded (text-only inference)
